title: Mechanisms and therapeutic perspectives of mucosal glycosylation-innate immunity crosstalk in inflammatory bowel disease (Review).
snippet: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a group of chronic, relapsing inflammatory disorders of the gastrointestinal tract, driven by a complex interplay of genetic susceptibility, environmental exposures, intestinal microbiota dysbiosis and immune dysregulation.
